scenarios.name: Hero Section Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently, enabling users to understand MirDB's purpose within 5 seconds

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL and wait for page load
steps.context: User arrives at homepage from search, GitHub, or referral

steps.description: Check that product name 'MirDB' is visible in the viewport without scrolling
steps.context: Hero section should be above the fold on standard screen sizes

steps.description: Confirm tagline communicating persistent key-value store with memcached compatibility is visible
steps.context: Tagline options include 'Memcached, but persistent.' or similar

steps.description: Check for primary call-to-action buttons (e.g., Get Started, View on GitHub)
steps.context: CTAs should guide users to next steps

test_cases.input: Load homepage and check for product name in hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is visible within the viewport on page load

test_cases.input: Check hero section for value proposition text
test_cases.expected: Text mentioning 'persistent key-value store' and 'memcached' compatibility is present

test_cases.input: Verify CTA buttons in hero section
test_cases.expected: At least one CTA button linking to quick start or GitHub repository exists

test_cases.input: Render hero section component in isolation
test_cases.expected: Hero component renders with required props for name, tagline, and CTAs

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Documentation

steps.description: Check that expected responses (STORED, VALUE, DELETED, etc.) are shown
steps.context: Helps users understand successful vs failed operations

test_cases.input: Check commands section for DELETE command

test_cases.input: Verify command examples show expected responses
test_cases.expected: Examples include response formats like STORED, VALUE, DELETED, END

test_cases.input: Render command table or list component
test_cases.expected: Commands are displayed in a structured table or list format
